decision_rule: Lowest mean validation WAPE among sets improving at least 4 of 5 folds over base

hypotheses_and_warnings.overfitting_caution: VALIDATION OVERFITTING CAUTION: Across the 8 evaluated feature sets on the served model (random_forest_raw), the spread between the best set (WAPE 0.5301) and base (WAPE 0.5357) is only 0.0056 (0.56% WAPE). Selecting among 8 candidate configurations over just 5 cross-validation folds can easily overfit the validation partitions. These modest differences demonstrate that tree ensemble predictions are overwhelmingly driven by base lag and rolling features, with prior-year seasonality (g3) providing small, consistent incremental stabilization.
hypotheses_and_warnings.guest_share_4w: HYPOTHESIS FLAG: 'guest_share_4w' is derived from missing CustomerID values in the UCI dataset. Missing CustomerID is not documented as a confirmed guest checkout and may represent wholesale walk-in purchases or cashier omission. It is retained strictly as an exploratory hypothesis.
hypotheses_and_warnings.unproven_groups: Groups ['g2', 'g4'] are classified as UNPROVEN on the served model (random_forest_raw) because they failed to demonstrate consistent improvements under the 4-of-5 fold validation rule.
hypotheses_and_warnings.weeks_to_christmas: DROPPED: 'weeks_to_christmas' showed no consistent gain (+0.0012 on Ridge, -0.0003 on RF, +0.0016 on LightGBM) and was dropped. In single-year datasets, countdown variables risk acting as surrogate time indices.
